submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv showed that the only exposure with a notable raw association with tensile_mpa was press_time (r≈0.22), but this was almost entirely confounded with lab (lab explains 35% of press_time variance, p≈6e-37). After adjusting for lab, no exposure was significant at alpha=0.05; press_time was the strongest lab-adjusted candidate (t≈-1.47, p≈0.14) with consistently negative within-lab correlations. The pre-registered confirmatory OLS of tensile_mpa on press_time plus lab indicators on held-out data gave estimate -0.095 (SE 0.133), p=0.476, not significant. The candidate effect did not replicate, so no direct effect is confirmed.

"}
